signalOfTheWeek.headline: Tessary: first enterprise account executive role
signalOfTheWeek.body: First enterprise account executive role. Companies at this stage usually start a compliance program within a quarter. This is sample data, shown until the engine produces a real week.

niches.name: SOC 2 / compliance automation
niches.description: Companies about to need a compliance program: first security hires, enterprise deals and fresh funding.
niches.talkTo: Head of Security, or the CTO at companies under 100 people

companies.name: Tessary
companies.whyNow: First enterprise account executive role. Companies at this stage usually start a compliance program within a quarter.
companies.opener: Congrats on the enterprise push. Happy to share how teams your size get SOC 2 done before the first big deal asks for it.

signals.label: Job posts mention SOC 2 and security questionnaires

companies.whyNow: First security engineer role, right after a trust page appeared on their site. Security reviews tend to land on a team that does not exist yet.
